note: A role is a part of the build that prd.md lets the team cut when time runs out (cut order: passkey and capabilities, then the glass TLS 1.3 server role, then the SSH server role). A clause that needs a cut role reports NOT RUN ROLE_CUT with the role name. Only the acceptance author or the lead changes this file, in a pull request that names the reason. Builders never write under acceptance/ (D11).
